{"reason":"Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) filters six of eight shown false arbitrations with confidence 0.44–0.67, retaining the 0.83 and 0.91 cases. V1’s 20/28 false arbitrations (FAR 0.714) dominate its 0.286 fitness; this gate targets those failures while preserving magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon safeguards.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
